facts.fact: No: PMFBY is optional for all farmers, including loanee farmers with a KCC/crop loan
facts.quote: The scheme is optional for all farmers including farmers who have been sanctioned short-term Seasonal Agricultural Operations (SAO) loans/Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for the notiﬁed crops

facts.fact: It has been voluntary since the revamped PMFBY from Kharif 2020
facts.quote: Since, the Revamped PMFBY is being implemented from Kharif 2020, and has been made voluntary for all the farmers

facts.fact: An existing loanee farmer who does not want cover gives a declaration (opt-out) to the loan-sanctioning bank branch, any time in the year but at least 7 days before the season's enrolment cut-off
facts.quote: the option of opting-out from the Schemes by submitting requisite declaration to loan sanctioning bank branches any time during the year but at least seven days prior to the cut-off date for enrolment of farmers for the respective season.

facts.fact: A loanee farmer who does not submit the opt-out declaration is covered automatically
facts.quote: In case no such "Opt-out" declaration is submitted by the farmer for the season, he/she will be automatically covered for the season.

facts.fact: For covered loanee farmers the bank debits the farmer's share of premium
facts.quote: Banks need to debit farmer's share of premium in the last 7 days upto enrolment cut-off date.

facts.fact: A farmer whose KCC/crop loan has become sub-standard is not treated as a loanee and may enrol as a non-loanee
facts.quote: considered as a Loanee farmer. However, bank branches may facilitate such farmers for enrolment as non-loanee farmers.

facts.fact: A crop loan sanctioned only against FD, gold or other collateral, without insurable interest in the land and crop, is not eligible for coverage
facts.quote: Merely, sanctioning of crop loan against other collateral securities including ﬁxed deposits, gold/jewel loans, mortgage loans etc. without having insurable interest of the farmer on the insurable land and notiﬁed crops shall not be eligible for coverage under the Scheme.

summary: All facts confirmed in the Revamped Operational Guidelines (17 Aug 2020) on pmfby.gov.in: voluntary for all since Kharif 2020, opt-out at least 7 days before cut-off, auto-cover with premium debit, sub-standard KCC and collateral-only loans.
